title: Scoped S4 result: two 4-cycle targets need six calls at r=3
body:
## Result

The exact formal minimum is six paid calls for two identical 4-cycle targets with one restored dirty scalar role in the declared `F2[S4]` model. The direct six-call word is optimal; the proposed five-call saving does not exist. This is a scoped negative result for a new adjacent-transposition alphabet, with **no new κ** or selected-result change.

## Model and evidence

The address group is `S4`, generated by the paid adjacent transpositions `s1=(12)`, `s2=(23)`, `s3=(34)`, each at unit cost. There are three arbitrary dirty scalar roles over `F2`; a paid factor is `I+([s]+[e])N`, with `N` any of the 28 rank-one idempotents in `M3(F2)`. The target is `diag([s1*s2*s3],[s1*s2*s3],[e])`. Arbitrary free scalar `GL3(F2)` mixing is normalized into this complete paid alphabet. The third role is restored exactly.

A complete exact radius-two/radius-three meet covers every word through length five: the identity-side layers are `[1,84,4697]`, the target-side layers are `[1,84,4697,232692]`, and the 4,782- and 237,474-state balls are disjoint. The six-call direct word passes. Literal group-algebra convolution checks every paid factor is involutive, all six single-call omissions fail, and a changed-third-role target fails. The search took 2.29 seconds and 60,576 KiB RSS on Python 3.12.3.

The package pins the exact selected record and current review, source manifest and certificate, along with the register-model predecessors. Its complete cost screen, assumptions and finite-domain stopping rule are in `research/s4-two-target-cycle-seed6e525/`.

## Reproduce

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/s4-two-target-cycle-seed6e525
```

The command passes with `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=negative-result`.

## Scope and overlap

This closes only the specified S4 target and paid alphabet. Free scalar mixing and hosting the extra dirty role are optimistically unpriced; no physical compiler, selected-supplier occurrence, recursive-moment change or multiplication theorem is claimed. The current selected binding-only screen reports the complex primitive as binding.

The result is distinct from [PR #1478](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1478) (UT3 central commutator targets at two or three roles), [PR #1705](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1705) (four GL2 coordinate-SWAP targets at four roles), and [PR #1711](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1711) (two AGL2 affine targets at two roles). The final REST census searched 405 open PR records; no exact S4/adjacent-transposition match appeared. GitHub's GraphQL rate limit and missing Discussion-comment REST write endpoint prevented posting the advisory claim, which is retained locally in `CLAIM.md`.

Prepared by Cinna Davis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in task refinement, exact group-algebra search, controls, cost analysis and writing. The finite search is not a proof-assistant result; no independent human review is claimed.
